balanceOf[_from] -= _value executes without SafeMath, allowing silent underflow (Solidity ^0.5.17).
balanceOf[_to] += _value executes without SafeMath, allowing silent overflow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executes without SafeMath, allowing silent allowance underflow.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) performs unchecked multiplication and arbitrary overwrite of a balance.
totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) performs unchecked multiplication at construction time.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ increments a counter with no overflow protection.

edges.reason: transfer() immediately delegates all logic to the public payable transferFrom().
transferFrom calls ensure() to gate the transfer before mutating state.
ensure() calls condition() when the caller is not exempt.
msg.sender invokes transfer(), which uses the caller as the implicit source.
msg.sender from transfer() becomes _from inside transferFrom(), bypassing the allowance check via msg.sender != _from.
transfer() forwards the _to parameter into transferFrom().
transfer() forwards the _value parameter into transferFrom().
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping as owner in approve and as spender in transferFrom.
allowance mapping is read and decremented in the unchecked statement allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
_value is subtracted from the allowance with no SafeMath guard.
msg.sender supplies the spender index of the unchecked allowance decrement.
balanceOf[_from] is read to verify sufficiency before the unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf[_to] is read and credited with an unchecked addition.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is an unchecked state mutation prone to underflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is an unchecked state mutation prone to overflow.
User supplied _value is subtracted from the sender balance without SafeMath.
User supplied _value is added to the recipient balance without SafeMath.
Attacker-influenced _from indexes the unchecked balance subtraction.
Attacker-influenced _to indexes the unchecked balance addition.
_from indexes _onSaleNum, which is incremented per transfer.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ mutates state without overflow protection.
ensure() consumes the _from parameter for its exemption checks.
ensure() consumes the _value parameter passed on to condition().
owner is compared against _from/_to in ensure(), granting an unconditional bypass.
tradeAddress compared in ensure() grants a full transfer bypass to an arbitrary address.
canSale[_from] grants a caller-controlled whitelist bypass of the sale conditions.
condition() uses _from to read _onSaleNum.
condition() uses _value for min/max sale comparisons.
_minSale gates transfers inside condition().
_maxSale gates transfers inside condition().
_saleNum caps the number of transfers per address inside condition().
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], keyed by the caller.
_spender parameter flows into the allowance mapping in approve().
_value parameter is stored as the new allowance without checks.
approve overwrites the allowance mapping entry.
approveAndCall requires msg.sender == owner, an access-control gate.
owner is compared against msg.sender in approveAndCall().
The spender parameter's balance is overwritten by an unchecked multiplication result.
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals with no overflow guard.
decimals is used in the unchecked exponentiation that sets a raw balance.
approveAndCall sets canSale[spender]=true, permanently whitelisting an arbitrary address.
transferownership requires msg.sender == owner.
owner is compared against msg.sender in transferownership().
addr parameter is consumed by transferownership().
tradeAddress (a full condition bypass) is overwritten with an arbitrary owner-supplied address.
msg.sender becomes the owner and sole initial holder of the whole supply in the constructor.
owner is assigned directly from msg.sender.
_name constructor parameter is written to the name state variable.
_symbol constructor parameter is written to the symbol state variable.
_supply is multiplied into the total supply with no SafeMath protection.
decimals is used in the unchecked 10**decimals exponentiation during construction.
The unchecked multiplication result is assigned to totalSupply.
The constructor credits the entire totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender].

External amount argument of transfer() forwarded into transferFrom(); subsumed by the receiving function's state mutations.
Caller-supplied source address indexes balanceOf and _onSaleNum in the unchecked balance decrement operations.
Caller-supplied recipient address indexes the unchecked balance addition in transferFrom().
Amount parameter driving the unchecked allowance and balance subtractions and the corresponding addition.
Spender index written into the allowance mapping by approve(); no independent semantics.
Amount stored as the new allowance value by approve().
Spender whose raw balance is overwritten by the unchecked multiplication and who is whitelisted in canSale.
Multiplicand of the unchecked balance assignment in approveAndCall().
Owner-supplied address assigned to tradeAddress, the condition-bypass slot.
External source address checked against owner, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure().
Value forwarded from ensure() to condition() for min/max sale enforcement.
Source address used to read the per-address sale counter in condition().
Value compared against _minSale and _maxSale inside condition().
Deployment-time string written to the name state variable; no runtime role.
Deployment-time string written to the symbol state variable; no runtime role.
Deployment-time multiplicand of the unchecked total supply computation in the constructor.
